Dialogs.Dialog: Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
...Hmm？
Have you been getting close to a classmate in the tennis club lately？
I wonder if she means ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Have you been getting close to an underclassman on the library committee lately？
I wonder if she means ▲小早川＊▲.
So it's true. Look at you~
'Look at me'？ What's that supposed to mean？
Well, doesn't that mean you're popular？ ...Am I wrong？
(I wonder...)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
Hm？ What？
Made any progress with that classmate from the tennis club？
She means ▲高嶺＊＊▲, huh...？
Made any progress with your underclassman on the library committee？
She means ▲小早川＊▲, huh...？
Come on, spill！ How is it going？
'Progress'？ It's not really like that, though.
Aw, really？ Hmm, you're being awfully vague.
Phew, I've finished my work today...
Ah, a message...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ sent me a message？ She's just left. I wonder if she forgot something here.
Please come behind the school building. Nene
(She sent me a message asking me to meet her...)
(But why at school...？)
(In the backyard...)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲。
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
What's up, all of a sudden？ And why at school？
Yeah, anywhere would've been fine, really... I just wanted a change of pace, I guess.
When we first met, I kinda thought you were a little unreliable.
Hmm... You might be right.
Fufu. But you've really grown. At work, and in other ways too.
Other ways？
Yeah. Like looking out for me. Sometimes you even felt older than me, you know...？
Really？ Sorry about that.
Ah, no, that's not it. I wanted to thank you.
Eh？
I told you, didn't I？ I'm really not someone people should rely on so much.
When you told me I didn't have to push myself, it made me really happy.
I'm so glad I got a junior like you.
I hope you'll always be my cute, sometimes-dependable junior.
Of course. If you're happy with ●, that is.
Okay... Thanks.
Phew, I've finished my work today...
Ah, a message...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ sent me a message？ She's just left. I wonder if she forgot something here.
Please come behind the school building. Nene
(She sent me a message asking me to meet her...)
(But why at school...？)
(In the backyard...)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
A dream, huh...？
(Takes me back to when ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ confessed to me...)
Phew, I've finished my work today...
Telephone... From ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Although she has just left...
Hello...
Anegasaki
Hello. Um...
(She called me out...)
(But, why at school？)
(In the backyard, huh...？)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
▲主人公＊▲。
A dream, huh...？
(Takes me back to when ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ confessed to me...)
Phew, just a little bit more until today's job is done. I'll just hang in there！
Anegasaki
Hey.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Did you finish your work early today？
Well...
(She said she had something to talk to me after I finished my work. What could it be...？)
(And, why at school...？)
(In the backyard, huh...？)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
▲主人公＊▲。
A dream, huh...？
(Takes me back to when ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ confessed to me...)
Phew, I've finished my work today...
Ah, a message...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ sent me a message？ She's just left. I wonder if she forgot something here.
Please come behind the school building. Nene
(She sent me a message asking me to meet her...)
(But why at school...？)
(In the backyard...)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
Hey now, you already have a cute girlfriend, don't you？ Bad boy！
Eh！？
Huh...？ What, it was just a dream...？
(Having a dream like that... I feel so bad for my girlfriend.)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
...Hmm？
Hey... don't you think my vibe is a little different, maybe？
Huh？ Hmm... In what way？
Not on the outside, on the inside, I mean...
The inside... Come to think of it, you do seem quieter.
Right. I thought I'd try to be a little more calm and composed.
True... But why all of a sudden？
I wonder. I just had a feeling you'd like me better that way.
(A calm ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... That might actually be nice.)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
...Hmm？
See？ Don't you think I give off a different impression？
Huh... Hmm... Do you think so？
You can't tell？ Jeez！ I'm not talking about my looks, you know？
Well... you do seem a bit more assertive, I guess.
Fufu, that's right. I figured I'd try being a little bolder from now on.
Bolder, huh... Yeah, maybe so. But why？
Eh？ Well, I just thought you might like that better.
(A bolder ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, huh... Might not be bad.)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
...Hmm？
Hey, don't you think I seem a little different？
Different... I don't know.
You really can't tell？ Jeez, what am I going to do with you. There, there.
W-Wait a sec...
Don't like this kind of big sister？
Not that I don't, but... Why all of a sudden？
Because I felt like you'd like a cheerful big sister like this.
(A cheerful ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, huh... Might be nice.)
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Do you go to Winning Burger often？
Anegasaki
Yeah, pretty often. Like on the way home from school.
Right？ That's pretty normal, I guess.
I don't know about normal, but... why do you ask？
I just wondered if there's anyone at our school who's never been there.
Hmm, that really would be pretty rare, I guess.
(Hmm... But what about ▲高嶺＊＊▲...？)
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. You know Towano Watcher, right？
Anegasaki
Yeah, of course. I check it sometimes.
I see. What do you think about someone who doesn't go out much... taking someone else out based solely on a magazine？
Well... there are definitely things you can't learn just from reading a magazine.
Right？
I think it'd be fine if there was someone else along to take the lead, though.
(Yeah, true... I wonder if ▲高嶺＊＊▲ will be okay.)
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. What do you think about going to practice chaperoning a date？
Anegasaki
Um... what do you mean？
I figured that's how you'd react.
So basically... it's a date, right？
Ooh, someone asked you out! Woo-woo~!
(Was that thing with ▲高嶺＊＊▲ a date？ Maybe I shouldn't have turned her down...)
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Do you ever hang out downtown at night, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Anegasaki
Of course not! Geez, what kind of person do you think I am？
Sorry. Yeah, figured as much.
Why？
I saw an underclassman there, so I was kind of worried.
I see. That sounds pretty dangerous, doesn't it？
(Yeah, it's definitely dangerous... ▲小早川＊▲...)
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Why would someone show up at school in casual clothes？
Anegasaki
Huh, you don't see that very often... What's up？
Well, an underclassman...
Hmm, yeah... Maybe something happened at home？
You think so, too...？
Maybe you should try talking to them？
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Do you ever go to convenience stores late at night, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Anegasaki
No way, that's too scary!
Yeah, figured. Hmm...
What do you mean？
I keep seeing an underclassman there, so I'm kind of worried.
That really is dangerous. They might have their reasons, though...
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
What's wrong？ Lost in thought？
If something's on your mind, you can talk to me, okay？
It's not really that, but... listen.
...Hmm？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you're ●'s girlfriend, right？
...Sorry. Weird thing to ask.
It's okay... Yeah. I'm your girlfriend.
Seriously though, what's wrong？
I was just thinking back on all kinds of stuff.
All kinds of stuff？
About ● and me. Like how a lot happened between when we met and started dating.
I see...
I get that... I know how that feels.
Really？
Yeah. When that happens to me, without fail, at the very end—
—I always end up thinking I'm so glad I'm with you.
Yeah... ● thought so, too.
Hehe, really？
Of course I did.
I'd like you to say things like that loud and clear, you know？
Yeah... I'm really glad I'm going out with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Yes...
(I'm so glad ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is ●'s girlfriend...)
